comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
I have seen these being sold for as low as 100k, and as high as 1m. They usually fall somewhere in-between, generally the 250k-500k range. I tend to gather mine in dungeons, and have never bought any, but the market is certainly there.

Since the item description is a bit vague... When you are exploring dungeons, your Stamina gauge will drop at regular intervals. The lower it becomes, the less maximum HP you will have while in battle in that dungeon.

Explorer's Household Medicine restores 70 points of lost stamina per item use to yourself, but not your fleetmates. This item can only be used outside of battle in the dungeons, as well. It is a good idea to fix them to a Quick Slot button for easy mass use while dungeoning.

Lastly, be advised that these items cannot be used to restore lost stamina while exploring the Labyrinth. It holds to a set of rules all its own.

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
(Just restating Gazi's recipe from above for personal reference):

These can now be made at Paracelcus Estate in Venice. They're also frequently dropped in EA dungeons, and possibly other dungeons as well.

Requirements: R11 Alchemy, R11 Handicrafts (20 vig per production)
Materials:
Gaseous Drug x1
Honey x10
Digitalis x10
Gives 4-5 meds per production

Item use/Notes: Restores 50 stamina in dungeons. Does not work in Atlantis/Labryrinth dungeon, as those dungeons use a different system for stamina. But can be very useful for EA dungeons, especially on lower floors or if exploring secret passages.

Great recipe for grinding alchemy!
